from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's title as written")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from context) found in this paper's reference list or bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
